title: Ashgrove CareAssure Unintentional Lapse Provision
content:
**Unintentional lapse — Asset-Based Long-Term Care Life Insurance (Ashgrove CareAssure)**

*Provision.* A policy that lapsed because the insured was cognitively impaired or had lost functional capacity before the lapse may be reinstated without evidence of insurability. The reinstatement request must be received no later than the lapse date plus the tier's unintentional lapse reinstatement period in calendar months. The deadline is found by adding the number of calendar months to the lapse date, falling back to the last day of the month when that day does not exist; a request received on the deadline is in time. The policy is reinstated only on a reinstatement request whose request status is approved, which requires a practitioner's certification that the impairment existed before the lapse. All past-due premiums must be paid, without interest. A lapse for any other reason cannot be reinstated; the insured may apply for new coverage.

*Records relied on.* The lapse date is the one on the policy record; the received date, the request status and the certification that the impairment preceded the lapse are those of that same reinstatement request on the company's record.

*Effect.* On reinstatement the policy returns from Lapsed to In Force, with a reinstatement date and a paid-to date that reflects the past-due premiums paid.

### The deadline — dated cases (hypothetical; CareAssure tiers allow 5 calendar months)

| Lapse date | Lapse date plus 5 calendar months | Deadline | Request received | In time |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 11 May 2026 | 11 October 2026 | 11 October 2026 | 11 October 2026 | Yes — received on the deadline |
| 11 May 2026 | 11 October 2026 | 11 October 2026 | 12 October 2026 | No |
| 30 September 2026 | 30 February 2027 does not exist | 28 February 2027 | 28 February 2027 | Yes |
| 31 January 2026 | 31 June 2026 does not exist | 30 June 2026 | 1 July 2026 | No |

### Conditions read together

| Lapse caused by impairment existing before the lapse | Request received by the deadline | Request status approved | Reinstatement under this provision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Reinstated, on payment of all past-due premiums without interest |
| Yes | No | — | Not reinstated |
| Yes | Yes | No | Not reinstated |
| No (any other reason) | — | — | Cannot be reinstated; the insured may apply for new coverage |

*Points of judgement.*
- No evidence of insurability is required under this provision.
- Past-due premiums carry no interest; the amount due is the past-due premiums themselves.
